feature_notes.serde_json_float_roundtrip: Still enabled on the host resolve because jsonschema 0.57.0 depends on serde_json with feature float_roundtrip. The oo-core edge does not request float_roundtrip. Exact amounts stay decimal strings.
feature_notes.preserve_order_and_raw_value: Not enabled. schemars preserve_order and raw_value were not turned on.
feature_notes.getrandom_host_edges: cargo tree shows getrandom 0.3.4 -> cfg-if 1.0.5 and libc 0.2.189. wasm-bindgen and js-sys are not edges on this platform.
feature_notes.uuid_simd: jsonschema 0.57.0 depends on uuid-simd 0.8.0 with default-features false and features std, detect. It is in the host graph. The published crate has no LICENSE file. Manifest license is MIT.
feature_notes.arrow_crate: not admitted. Arrow series-60 display strings are produced by oo-core and are not an arrow-schema Display comparison.
feature_notes.serde_json_arbitrary_precision: Enabled because oo-core depends on serde_json 1.0.151 with feature arbitrary_precision. The feature is workspace-wide for this pin. JSON numbers reach oo-core as lexical decimal strings. A predicate that rejects a large f64 after rounding is not the parser. YAML numbers use granit-parser events, not serde_json's f64.
feature_notes.chrono: Host features alloc and std. clock, wasmbind, and oldtime are off. iana-time-zone, windows-link, wasm-bindgen, and js-sys are not reachable from oo-core.
feature_notes.chrono_tz: Host feature std. case-insensitive and filter-by-regex off. IANA tzdb string in the prebuilt table is 2025b. chrono-tz-build is not in the lock.
feature_notes.phf: Host feature list is empty. macros is off. phf_macros is not a dependency.
feature_notes.siphasher: Host features default and std. Direct pin 1.0.3. 1.0.4 refused for age.
feature_notes.encoding_rs: Version pin 0.8.41. oo-core source does not call it. Host features alloc and default, via the direct pin and via encoding_rs_io. This is not a GB18030 decoder.

build_scripts.host: Build scripts reached on aarch64-apple-darwin are cfg or rustc version probes (println, autocfg, version_check, rustc_version), plus the chrono-tz 0.10.4 build.rs described in host_chrono_tz. No C compiler invocation was observed for the host closure.
build_scripts.other_target_wasm_bindgen_shared: build.rs runs git rev-parse and emits cargo:rustc-env. The audit heuristic matched the substring bindgen. It does not compile C. The crate is not in the host graph.
build_scripts.other_target_wit_bindgen: On a non-wasm target the build script returns immediately. On wasm32 it copies the shipped static archive src/rt/libwit_bindgen_cabi.a and emits cargo:rustc-link-lib=static. That path was not executed. The crate is not in the host graph. A wasm32 build is blocked by the age of wasm-bindgen 0.2.129 and js-sys 0.3.106.
build_scripts.host_chrono_tz: chrono-tz 0.10.4 build.rs is 545 bytes and cargo runs it. chrono_tz_build::main is cfg-gated on filter-by-regex and case-insensitive. Both are off, so the call is not compiled. chrono-tz-build is not in Cargo.lock. No C compiler invocation.
